scenario_scope: Triage Corben's functional rate-distortion, behavior-preserving precision, progressive residual, routed execution, and certificate proposal against the current compression and governance owners.

cases.decision_rationale: Functional rate-distortion and certification deepen the existing compressed-artifact admission lease; residual planes, runtime routing, complete cost, readiness, formal refinement, custody, and adaptive-resource decisions each have an explicit current owner. Coordinated integration preserves one end-to-end contract without duplicating those chapter jobs.
required_before_drafting: completed full paper reading and pair verification
preserve argument-only support and explicit nonclaims
respect the active existing-book work order
evidence_transition_preconditions: competent matched static and routed implementations
promotion_blockers: no functional precision compiler or certificate verifier
non_claims: does not make any source-reported quantization result local evidence

cases.decision_rationale: A standalone owner is justified only if completed integration shows that representation invariance, precision-field allocation, compiler lifecycle, and certificate semantics cannot be taught coherently without fragmenting or overloading the present owners. The current structural freeze and WIP order prohibit admission now.
required_before_drafting: terminal R16-A, W3, and T1D packets
birth-complete atom, reader, ownership, and inheritance packet if admitted
evidence_transition_preconditions: empirical movement requires a competent matched functional-precision campaign
no source result inherits chapter-core support
promotion_blockers: existing owners have not yet failed the coherence test
no implemented compiler or distinct chapter-owning evidence surface
non_claims: does not reserve a chapter position or guarantee admission
does not create a chapter file, manifest row, proof target, or reader insertion

validation_boundary: Records a passage-reviewed source integration and an evidence-gated standalone-owner contingency. It validates neither the paper's architecture nor a universal precision bound, behavior preservation, compression advantage, certificate validity, transfer, or support movement.
non_claims: does not change chapter count or order
does not authorize protected empirical work
does not publish the raw paper
does not authorize release, deployment, or publication
